description: Elections Commission - R. B. H. Niroshana of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - J. M. N. Ranasinghe of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as Members of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including candidate registrations, vacancies, and election-related declarations.
